subtasks.title: Summarize Invoice March.pdf
subtasks.instruction: Read ~/Downloads/Invoice March.pdf and write a three-line summary to ~/Documents/PDF Summary parts/Invoice March.txt.

subtasks.title: Summarize Lease.pdf
subtasks.instruction: Read ~/Downloads/Lease.pdf and write a three-line summary to ~/Documents/PDF Summary parts/Lease.txt.

subtasks.title: Write the PDF Summary note
subtasks.instruction: Read the two files in ~/Documents/PDF Summary parts and write them into one new note at ~/Documents/PDF Summary.md.

subtasks.title: Paste the summary into Notes
subtasks.instruction: Open ~/Documents/PDF Summary.md, copy its text, and paste it into a new note in Notes called PDF Summary.
